image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Pliosaurus funkei from the config library in a state of utter exhaustion at the finish line. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Orca-style black and white high-contrast coloring; pearlescent clay texture. ACTION: He has come to a dead stop, drifting lethargically on his side like a massive, heavy, black-and-white submarine. His flippers are dangling motionless, completely drained of energy. FACIAL EXPRESSION: His eyes are half-closed in a comically miserable, sleepy expression. His massive, powerful jaws are slack, and a comically oversized 'drool' bubble is escaping from the corner of his mouth. SETTING: The finish line, with soft, dim light. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with physical comedy. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' medium-shot, showing the scale of his exhaustion.
